Subject: Your maritime salvage claim matter (Project Osprey)

Dear Ms. Rathore,

Thank you for meeting us on 17/09/2021 about your dispute with M/s Sunrise Shipping Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the owners dispute the value of the salvage. The matter is listed before the Karnataka High Court.

Our advice is to claim a salvage award based on the value of the property saved. Please collect the valuation of the vessel and cargo and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
